fbs_normal.en: Your fasting blood sugar is in the normal range. Keep eating a balanced diet with plenty of vegetables, fruit, and whole grains, and stay active most days.
fbs_normal.gil: Your fasting blood sugar is in the normal range. Keep eating a balanced diet with plenty of vegetables, fruit, and whole grains, and stay active most days.

fbs_prediabetes.en: Your fasting blood sugar is a little higher than normal. Cut back on sugary drinks and white rice/bread, eat more vegetables and fish, and try to walk regularly. Talk to a nurse or doctor about this reading.
fbs_prediabetes.gil: Your fasting blood sugar is a little higher than normal. Cut back on sugary drinks and white rice/bread, eat more vegetables and fish, and try to walk regularly. Talk to a nurse or doctor about this reading.

fbs_diabetes.en: Your fasting blood sugar is in the diabetes range. Please see a doctor or nurse soon. In the meantime, avoid sugary drinks and snacks, favor vegetables, fish, and small portions of rice, and stay active.
fbs_diabetes.gil: Your fasting blood sugar is in the diabetes range. Please see a doctor or nurse soon. In the meantime, avoid sugary drinks and snacks, favor vegetables, fish, and small portions of rice, and stay active.
